senses.gloss: badalā (Chamba), return, exchange; same as parata.
badara, same as tolaka (q. v.) or tolā.
badara , same as tola or tolaka.

ba-di (IE 8-1; CII 3; etc.), contraction of bahula-pakṣa-dina or ˚divasa; also spelt va-di, cf. śu-di; abbreviations of separate words (see ba, di, śu and va) and not words in themselves, ba-di or va-di referring to the dark fortnight and śu-di the bright fortnight; they denote the fortnight and the solar or civil day, with reference to the lunar tithi, in the fortnight.
